newsitem.title: USA: U.S.Robotics in six lawsuits over merger.
newsitem.headline: U.S.Robotics in six lawsuits over merger.

text.p: U.S. Robotics Corp said Tuesday it and certain of its directors have been named as defendants in six lawsuits relating to its proposed merger with 3Com Corp, but believes the suits are without merit.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, U.S. Robotics said 3Com was also named as a defendant in five of the suits.
The suits, which were filed in the Delaware Chancery Court, seek an injunction against the merger and unspecified damages, U.S. Robotics said.

"The lawsuits, which purport to be stockholder class actions brought on behalf of all USR stockholders, allege that the directors of USR have breached their fiduciary duties by approving the merger agreement, and that 3Com has aided and abetted this alleged breach of duty," U.S. Robotics said.
"USR believes that these lawsuits are without merit and intends to contest them vigorously," the company said.
U.S. Robotics and 3Com have agreed to merge in a stock deal valued at $7.3 billion.
